extraction.Name: William Brown
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Land all mortgaged for $4227 to R. C. Spinning, Mortgage paid off and new mortgage given on 80 acres, which was foreclosed.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: no land sold for debt or taxes; mortgage foreclosed on 80 acres
extraction.Occupation/Income: Shares in annuity to Pawnee Indians
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent Feb. 15, 1918 by mail; receipted for: yes; no property or money accumulated; fair health; no persons dependent upon him for support; has no inherited lands or interest; allottee says that the mortgages to R. C. Spinning were executed by him but that he received very little of the money — Mr. Spinning told him he would keep the money for him and pay it out in small sums as he needed funds; allottee says the last mortgage of $1800 was not paid to him at all; including sale and mortgages, the allottee should have received $6027 for the land, which he says was not a fair price for the land at that time; document notarized November 28, 1928, Pawnee County, Oklahoma; commission expires Jan. 31, 1929
